name: Kessler Field
description: A shattered mining platform drifts in a debris belt patrolled by Compact pickets.
briefing: Debris field, three contacts. Get the outpost out and don't linger.

name: Halcyon Rescue
description: A colony transport limps through wreckage, jamming every channel with distress calls.
briefing: Colony's still transmitting. Get in, get them out, watch the derelict.

name: Ridgeline
description: A forested ridge overlooking an occupied valley, contested by dug-in Compact patrols.
briefing: Ridge line's held by Compact patrols. Take the outpost, mind the convoy.

name: Lowtown
description: A refugee convoy threads through a bombed-out urban district under Compact fire.
briefing: Convoy's pinned in Lowtown. Clear a corridor and get them moving.

name: The Anvil
description: A derelict shipyard hangs in a gravity well, its structure hulls turned into chokepoints.
briefing: Gravity well and Compact steel. Hold the relay, hold the station.

name: Saltflats
description: A dust storm rolls across open salt flats littered with downed frames worth salvaging.
briefing: Open ground, dust storm inbound. Grab what's salvageable and get out.

name: The Gate
description: The final checkpoint before the inner colonies — and the rival's personal hunting ground.
briefing: This is the gate. Hit the target hard — I want everyone back on the Lantern.

name: Ashline Corridor
description: A river corridor between two ridgelines. The Compact holds the crossings, the fuel dump and the colony plateau. Take and hold the ground — or cut the head off.
briefing: Five holdings along the Ashline. Hold three of them for ninety seconds and the corridor is ours — or find their commander and end it the short way. They will take them back if you let them.

name: Kessler Anchorage
description: A shipping anchorage strung between debris fields. The Compact runs the mooring spars and the fuel tender; take three and the lane is ours.
briefing: Kessler Anchorage. Five moorings, and the Lantern is on the map with us — mind her. Hold three for ninety seconds, or gut their picket command.
